rationale: Both options describe paired control/treatment prompts. Option B stresses fixing wording word for word and reusing it across every model, seed and sample, which helps attribute differences to sampling stochasticity and keeps the evaluation lightweight and portable, as this evaluator would like. Option A specifies ten samples at a fixed temperature, which is concrete and cheap, but it says less about holding the prompts fixed across models. The two are close, so B has only a modest edge.
